test_title: PYST 16: SSC MTS 2023 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question:
The bar graph shows the average marks scored in Mathematics examination (out of 100) by students of 6 divisions of XIIth standard.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe50592b290eed59b4563d34822c6198836240a3de31c7b1a85c79d52fbb96a4.png] 

What is the ratio of the average marks scored by Division B to Division D?
solution:
**Given:**

The average marks scored by Division B is 45 and Division D is 65.

**Concept Used:**

Ratio is calculated by dividing one quantity by another.

**Calculation:**

We have,

⇒ Ratio = (Average marks of Division B) / (Average marks of Division D)

⇒ Ratio = 45 / 65

⇒ Simplifying the fraction, we get:

⇒ Ratio = 9 / 13

**Hence, the ratio of the average marks scored by Division B to Division D is 9 ∶ 13.**
